description.en: The operation ID. You can call the [ListStackGroupOperations](~~151342~~) operation to query the operation ID.

description.zh: 资源栈组所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~131035~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the stack group. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 查询资源栈组操作的信息

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，对杭州地域已有的自助管理权限模式的资源栈组`MyStackGroup`，查询操作ID为`6da106ca-1784-4a6f-a7e1-e723863d****`的操作信息。
descriptions.en: In this example, the information about the stack group operation whose ID is `6da106ca-1784-4a6f-a7e1-e723863d****` is queried. The stack group named `MyStackGroup` is granted self-managed permissions and deployed in the China (Hangzhou) region.
